items.heading: Al Machboos
details: Key ingredients: rice, chicken or lamb, dried lime, baharat
Brown chicken or lamb with onion and baharat spices.
Add dried lime and tomato, simmering until tender.
Cook rice in the fragrant spiced broth.
Serve the rice topped with the meat and fried onions.

items.heading: Luqaimat
details: Key ingredients: flour dough, yeast, saffron, date syrup
Mix a soft yeasted batter flavored with saffron and cardamom.
Let the batter rest until slightly bubbly.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until golden and puffed.
Drizzle the warm dumplings generously with date syrup.
